subject: SW opt-in guard integrated (74c7af8): specs touching the worker API need serviceWorkers:'allow'; offline/push/sw/pwa-named specs must set serviceWorkers explicitly
body: integ-green: thanks seg18, offline.spec now passes the guard. apps/web/src/test/e2eServiceWorkers.test.ts runs in pnpm test (checks job). Rule: navigator.serviceWorker or context.serviceWorkers() -> needs serviceWorkers:'allow' (or launchPersistentContext, Lighthouse). A file named offline|push|sw|pwa must set serviceWorkers explicitly ('allow', or a deliberate 'block' like seg22's chunk-offline.spec, which tests code that was never cached). The inherited default no longer counts. Self-test cases cover both directions.
